validation_queries.description: Overriding the cputime sampler signal must not disturb GPU kernel tracing
validation_queries.error_message: No kernels captured while ROCPROFSYS_SAMPLING_CPUTIME_SIGNAL was overridden
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM kernels

validation_queries.description: The cputime sampler must keep delivering samples on the overridden signal. 100 is a deliberately loose floor: the run records thousands, so this only catches a sampler that stopped firing, not a slow host
validation_queries.error_message: Fewer than 101 timer_sampling samples recorded; overriding ROCPROFSYS_SAMPLING_CPUTIME_SIGNAL stopped the cputime sampler from firing
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_sample R INNER JOIN rocpd_event E ON E.id = R.event_id AND E.guid = R.guid INNER JOIN rocpd_string S ON S.id = E.category_id AND S.guid = E.guid WHERE S.string = 'timer_sampling'
